$comment: Where a HAXcms backend runs and what a plugin can count on there (spec/14). `needs` are derived from a plugin's manifest by scripts/backend-needs.mjs; a backend says which target it is, and the loader compares the two. Read by the validator, the reference engine and both backends, so the table exists once.

visitors.title: a backend that visitors and other services can reach

secrets.title: secret settings kept on a server

server.title: hosted server
server.about: haxcms-nodejs or haxcms-php on a host people reach over the web

desktop.title: desktop app
desktop.about: haxcms-nodejs inside haxcms-desktop, on one person's computer

partial.schedule: jobs run only while the app is open

browser.title: browser
browser.about: haxcms-nodejs bundled into a Worker by haxcms-browser, in one person's browser tab

partial.network: only hosts that allow cross-origin requests answer
partial.secrets: kept in this browser's storage, where the person using it can read them
